query:
SELECT t.payee_id AS "payee_id!: lib_core::RowID", t.amount AS "amount!: lib_core::Money"
                    FROM transactions t
                    JOIN accounts a ON t.account_id = a.id
                    WHERE t.payee_id IS NOT NULL
                      AND a.unit_id = ?
                      AND t.date >= ?
                      AND t.date <= ?
